meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 简化药物研发中的分子分析工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做药物研发,常需要用代码处理化学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular analysis in drug research and development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery and want a friendlier way to process molecular data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能用 datamol 处理分子数据:解析 SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符与指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象等,产出的分子对象是原生 RDKit Mol。
howto.when: 当你要做常规药物发现里的分子处理任务(如解析 SMILES、标准化结构、算描述符等)时用它;原文提示需要更高级控制或自定义参数时直接用 rdkit。

howto.what_en: With datamol installed, Claude works with molecular data in Python: parsing SMILES, standardizing structures, computing descriptors and fingerprints, clustering, generating 3D conformers, and more. Results are native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Use it for standard drug-discovery work such as parsing SMILES, standardizing structures, or computing descriptors; for advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

say_en.text: Read this SDF file, standardize the molecules, and save it as parquet
Compute descriptors and ECFP4 fingerprints for these molecules in parallel
Cluster these molecules with Butina clustering by similarity
